department: College of Graduate Studies — Ph.D. in Biomedical Sciences

deadline.value: Application opens September 1, 2026 and the final deadline is December 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: Application Timeline | Opens: Sept. 1, 2026 | Final deadline: Dec. 1, 2026

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for the biomedical sciences, and standardized test scores are not required.
gre_subject.quote: Submission of a standardized test score is not required but will be considered if submitted.

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: No supervisor is required prior to admission; first-year students complete laboratory rotations before selecting a mentor.
supervisor.quote: In this residential, research intensive program, you will build scientific independence through rigorous coursework, faculty mentorship, laboratory rotations, and immersive research training

funding.value: Students in the Ph.D. in Biomedical Sciences program receive a $39,000 annual stipend (effective July 1, 2026) plus full coverage of tuition, fees, and health insurance.
funding.quote: Students in the Ph.D. in Biomedical Sciences program at MUSC receive a $39,000 annual stipend, effective July 1, 2026. The program also covers tuition, fees and health insurance for these students.

entry_route.value: Applicants must possess or expect to earn a bachelor’s degree from an accredited U.S. institution or foreign equivalent prior to enrolling.
entry_route.quote: Possess, or expect to have earned, a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in the U.S. or its equivalent from a foreign institution prior to enrolling

notes: MUSC also offers a separate Ph.D. in Drug Discovery and a joint Clemson-MUSC Ph.D. in Biomedical Data Science & Informatics.
